name: card
summary: Presents admitted body content on a neutral surface with optional heading, supporting text, and actions.

agent.useWhen: A bounded piece of content needs a neutral surface, optional local heading, or separate action region.
agent.avoidWhen: Content is a page section or should remain unboxed in the surrounding flow.

invariants: Body and optional actions are separately host-admitted slots, never raw HTML instance strings.
Title and subtitle are escaped plain text; heading level is h2, h3, or h4.
The neutral div creates no landmark, interaction, script lifecycle, route, or command.
